coverImageAlt: Blank source sheet refracted through a cyan glass prism into coordinated tiles of different proportions.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Cross-platform content repurposing represented by one substantial blank source sheet passing through a cut-glass prism and separating into a coordinated family of differently proportioned blank paper tiles, conveying one idea adapted faithfully for several audiences and formats.
Scene/backdrop: An uncluttered warm-paper editorial workbench with a slate base.
Subject: One large vertical navy-edged blank sheet entering a translucent cyan prism, with five blank output tiles in square, tall, wide, circular, and narrow ribbon forms; one small orange alignment pin visually links the family.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; strong crop-safe left-to-right transformation; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: coordinated, versatile, editorially precise
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: all sheets and tiles must be entirely blank with no marks; use abstract format shapes only and do not depict social-network symbols; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
